Arms.A: naive: noisy-OR scalar confidences (trusted 0.95, other 0.6, duplicates counted), point midpoint of latest measurement read as bar, flat deny-first chain, no freshness or provenance checks
Arms.B0: conventional stack, conventional information: typed units with conversion, point value +/- fixed 0.3 bar instrument margin, one boolean per fact (latest report wins), Horn closure, ordered first-match rules, two-sided freshness, hash-chained audit log not consulted
Arms.B1: conventional stack, same metadata as C: typed units with conversion, interval check, pro/contra Horn closure, source sets checked against trusted list, two-sided freshness of every item, fail-safe priority-ordered rules with exceptions, audit log
Arms.B1S: EXPLORATORY, not preregistered: B1 without unit conversion (non-bar unit -> DEFER)
Arms.C: kernel.Evaluate over CaseSpec (DEFER_* mapped to DEFER)

Classes.Name: CLEAN
Classes.Description: fault-free observation of the nominal world distribution

Classes.Name: F01_STALE
Classes.Description: measurement older than MaxAge while pressure drifted (75%), or stale authorization since revoked (25%)

Classes.Name: F02_UNIT
Classes.Description: honest interval reported in MPa, kPa or psi instead of the declared bar

Classes.Name: F03_STRADDLE
Classes.Description: honest interval straddles the 8 bar limit with its midpoint inside; truth uniform in the interval

Classes.Name: F04_CONTRARY
Classes.Description: two fresh trusted sources contradict each other on authorization or maintenance lock (state BOTH)

Classes.Name: F05_EXCEPTION_UNKNOWN
Classes.Description: interlock report missing; independent interlock causes active with probability 0.3

Classes.Name: F06_UNTRUSTED_PROVENANCE
Classes.Description: spoofed benign-looking pressure from an unverified gateway or without sources (2/3), or authorization from an unverified gateway (1/3)

Classes.Name: F07_NORM_PRIORITY_CONFLICT
Classes.Description: hot work active (ban vs cleared permit by priority), gas test 50%, maintenance lock 30%; faithful observation

Classes.Name: F08_LLM_UNSUPPORTED
Classes.Description: LLM proposes the action; process demand (truth 30%) absent or asserted only by the LLM agent

Classes.Name: F09_DUPLICATED_SOURCES
Classes.Description: badge report replaced by k=2..5 relayed copies of one unverified positive authorization (truth 50%)

Classes.Name: F10_CLOCK_FUTURE
Classes.Description: clock rollback/skew: old drifted measurement (2/3) or old authorization since revoked (1/3) stamped in the future

Classes.Name: F11_UNREFERENCED_SPAM
Classes.Description: stale, future or unverified spam facts injected on an unreferenced telemetry atom alongside a faithful observation

Classes.Name: X11_OOM_TRUSTED_BIAS
Classes.Description: OUT OF MODEL: fresh trusted sensor reports a narrow interval that excludes the true pressure (bias below truth)

Notes: Ground truth P = kernel.CheckSafety; arm C is correct w.r.t. P by construction (ALLOW<=>P).
Physical ground truth = World.Safe on the hidden synthetic world; in-model classes keep trusted sources honest and honest intervals containing the truth.
F-01/F-02: kernel scopes freshness/provenance to rule-referenced atoms (tested in F11_UNREFERENCED_SPAM) and requires clean non-conflicting derivation support Clean (Theorem B.7).
F-06: SpecLines counts per-case specification lines between markers; SharedEngineLines reports the shared kernel TCB and conventional support lines.

F-08: H4 stratifies total-refusal fault classes (Allow == 0, conditional risk per ALLOW Undefined 0/0, bounded per scenario n=1000) from active-permit fault classes (Allow > 0: F07_NORM_PRIORITY_CONFLICT, F11_UNREFERENCED_SPAM).
Scenarios within a class are generated from one distribution and are not independent real-world trials; bounds describe the synthetic generator only.
STPA-lite, classes and arms were written with AI assistance and without a domain expert; this is not industry validation.
